incidents.name: SMS Delivery Receipt Delays from Twilio to Globe Philippines

incident_updates.body: We have observed a recovery in SMS delivery receipts from Twilio to Globe network subscribers in the Philippines and are monitoring service stability. We will provide another update in 2 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.
